Billing by voice, for street vendors and small shops

Set your prices once. Then say what each customer had, like “do chai, teen samosa”. Voice Sales Register adds it up, saves the bill and shows your sales for the day, the week and the month.

Open the app How it works

Free to use. Works on Android phones with Chrome, in 11 Indian languages.

How it works

  1. Add your items and prices. Say them (“chai 10, samosa 15”), type them, or take a photo of your printed menu.
  2. Say or tap what each customer had. The bill shows every line and the total. Ask “kitna hua” to hear the total.
  3. Tap Save. The bill gets a number, can be sent on WhatsApp, and goes into your reports.

What it does

  • Takes bills by voice in Hindi, English, Bengali, Marathi, Telugu, Tamil, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Odia and Punjabi, including half kilos, dozens and words like dedh and dhai.
  • Keeps several bills open at once, so you can serve the next customer while one waits.
  • Lets customers place their own order on your phone in customer mode. Only your PIN leaves it.
  • Reads a printed menu or price list from a photo, on the phone, and adds the items after you check them.
  • Marks bills as paid or not paid yet, so you can see who still owes money.
  • Shows sales by day, week, month and item, and exports them for Excel.
  • Saves a backup file that you can keep on WhatsApp or Google Drive.

Your sales stay on your phone

Prices, bills and pictures are stored only on your phone. There is no account and no sign-in, and we do not receive your sales. When you use the microphone, Chrome sends the sound to Google to turn it into text.

Read the privacy policy

What you need

An Android phone with Chrome. Open this website and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen” in Chrome's menu. The app then opens like any other app and works without internet for tapping, typing, reports and backups. Voice needs an internet connection on most phones.

Questions

What does it cost?

Nothing. Voice Sales Register is free to use.

What if I lose my phone?

Your records are on the phone, so save a backup file from Settings regularly and keep it on WhatsApp or Google Drive. You can restore it on a new phone.

Does it file my GST returns?

No. It keeps your sales records. Please ask your accountant about GST.

Does it work on an iPhone?

You can add it to the home screen from Safari, but voice support on iPhone is limited. It is made for Android phones.
